# Copilot instructions

Read [AGENTS.md](../AGENTS.md) and follow the shared [development
process](../docs/specs/process.md) before planning, editing, or reviewing changes.
These instructions also apply to delegated work.

Use the [contribution guide](../CONTRIBUTING.md) for setup, source layout,
validation commands, and documentation conventions. The [documentation
index](../docs/README.md) links to current tool contracts and historical designs.
Load the applicable [repository skill](../.agents/skills/README.md) before test
authoring, native tooling work, or specification review.

Follow existing platform adapters, subprocess helpers, error handling, and MCP
response conventions. Inspect the relevant implementation and tests rather than
assuming all tools share one response shape or execution strategy.
